findings.summary: Non-blocking (spec §5 style/preference lane): acceptance criterion 2 asks the URI-segment mutation set to include a non-greedy variant, but W2 substitutes two narrowing mutations ([^@]+ and [^:]+) plus a digest-width mutation instead. The selftest documents the evidence for the substitution — with backtracking, (.+?) is equivalent to (.+) here, so a non-greedy mutation cannot go red — and spec §0 line 80 explicitly required self-verification rather than copying the suggested regex. Discriminative intent (URI segment must not be narrowed, digest width must stay 64) is preserved and all three mutations are shown to go red, with restore verified via git diff --stat.

Non-blocking, pre-existing design carried forward verbatim from GT-1: because total is len(entries)+discarded and every entry increments exactly one of the five class counters, the conservation sum is structurally always equal to total, so sums_ok in practice degenerates to discarded == 0. D6 is satisfied as written and W9-mut proves dropping a term from the expression goes red, but the expression's only live signal is the discard bucket.
